info.name: ModFirst POS Payments
info.description: One generic POS payment API (POST /payments/pos/pay) covering every POS payment type: cash, bank transfer, Stripe Terminal (card-present), and the two splits (cash + bank, cash + terminal). Plus the Stripe Terminal action endpoints the app polls/captures for card-present. Admin JWT (authenticate).

request.description: THE single POS payment endpoint. All five payment_type options are documented inline. Pick one and send only its fields. The type is stored on the order as pos_payment_type.
Full cash payment. Recorded as paid immediately.
Full bank transfer. Recorded as paid immediately.
Card-present via a Stripe Terminal reader. Returns a payment_reference to poll + capture.
Split payment: part cash, part bank transfer. Amounts must equal the order total.
Split payment: part cash, part card-present. Terminal part must be polled + captured.
Poll this every ~2s after a terminal payment. Tells you whether the card has been presented and if the payment can be captured yet.
Capture the card-present payment after the customer has tapped/inserted their card.
Cancel the current action on the reader.
